scope: one paired training seed, four H200 arms, all 20 fixed evaluations
estimate_type: historical throughput extrapolation plus planning allowance; not a confidence interval

historical_training.method: Sum elapsed training time within each run segment; the seconds counter resets on resume.

historical_evaluation.coverage_validation: Full train730 jobs: 1460 generated PNGs and 4380 historical T1 readback records per measured receipt; resumed partial receipts excluded.
limitations: Historical readback has one sixth text-only controls, versus three forty-thirds here; higher image fraction can increase Reader cost.
Historical MCQ generations were 7 tokens each; random-init image effects on output length have not yet been measured.
Shared storage and repeated model loading add variable overhead.

recommendation: Start the four single-GPU training arms immediately. Use the same four GPUs for evaluation afterward. An additional four H200s can shorten evaluation wall time if they become available soon, but eight-GPU/cross-instance dispatch is not part of the current four-GPU controller.
resource_efficiency: Four cards match four training arms. Additional training DDP would change the execution design and is not required. Whole-endpoint evaluation has four large final train tasks and four official tasks, so additional GPUs do not provide linear total-runtime scaling.
future_calibration: Update from the independent prechecks and first 128 formal updates without changing the scientific protocol.
